name: Picture key
responsibility: Reads from a drawn picture what its key lists, for the page's legend and an exported one alike
description: pictureAppearances scans the drawn document without a DOM for each subject's applied appearance; keyOf keeps one sample of each node and relationship kind in drawing order; placedStanding keeps a comparison's standing to the subjects a drawing placed, and markCounts counts their marks. One reader, so the page's legend and an exported legend cannot list different things.
